article.title: illumin推出Ask Lu廣告助理，建案功能開放測試
article.summary: illumin宣布在全球逐步推出Ask Lu報表功能，團隊可對廣告數據提問，並將回答整理成報告。
highlights: Campaign Creation可參考過往廣告活動來建立和調整新活動，現為公開測試。
平台也開始在全球推出新版競價預測功能。
article.why: 代理商可以縮短從發現異常到提出調整方案的流程，仍可先核對數字再作決定。
article.next_step: 用已結案的活動比較Ask Lu與既有報表的花費和轉換數，再評估是否採用測試版建案。
article.detail: illumin表示，Ask Lu Reporting可將回答整理為摘要、報告及圖表。公司亦重建廣告競價前的預測機制，表示系統會納入更多因素以評估投放機會。兩項功能開始在全球推出，利用過往活動資料建立及調整活動的Campaign Creation則屬公開測試。媒體團隊可先選一個已知有異常的活動，核對工具能否指出差異發生在哪個環節。
article.title_en: illumin rolls out Ask Lu reporting and opens campaign creation beta
article.summary_en: illumin says it has begun rolling out Ask Lu Reporting globally. Teams can ask questions about their campaign data and turn answers into reports.
highlights_en: Campaign Creation can draw on earlier campaigns to build and refine new ones. It is in open beta.
The platform also began rolling out an updated pre-bid prediction system globally.
article.why_en: Agencies can shorten the path from spotting an anomaly to proposing a change while checking the numbers before acting.
article.next_step_en: Compare spend and conversions in Ask Lu with existing reports for a closed campaign before assessing the creation beta.
article.detail_en: illumin says Ask Lu Reporting can package answers into summaries, reports and charts. The company also rebuilt its pre-bid prediction system to consider more signals when assessing an ad opportunity. Both features are rolling out worldwide. Campaign Creation uses earlier campaign data to build and refine campaigns and remains in open beta. Media teams can use a campaign with a known anomaly to see if the assistant identifies where it arose.
